Word Wheel Quest blends crossword clues with a letter wheel.

Read each clue, swipe letters to spell words, and fill the grid at your own pace. Real crossword-style hints guide every answer—no noisy timers unless you turn one on.

HOW TO PLAY
• Swipe the wheel to form words
• Match them to the crossword grid
• Swipe the clue strip for the next hint

EXTRA FUN
• Bonus coins for real words not on the puzzle
• Gentle hints when you’re stuck
• Season levels and daily puzzles

Download Word Wheel Quest—one clue, one swipe at a time.
